apiNotice.title: API Key Required
apiNotice.description: This tool requires a Google Gemini API Key. Visit
apiNotice.descriptionSuffix: to get a free API Key, then enter it in 'API Settings' at the top right.

step1.title: Upload a main image, describe the motion

mainImage.label: Main image
mainImage.desc: 1 image to animate it, 2-3 to add reference elements; none for text only

idea.label: Motion
idea.desc: One sentence, e.g. "the product slowly rotates, soft light"

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.desc: Resolution, length, things to avoid, end frame (optional)

step2.title: Review the prompt
step2.descHighlight: subject & motion, setting, camera, lighting and sound
items: Click an alternative below a field to swap it in

step3.title: Generate

script.label: Compose the prompt
script.desc: Turn the fields into an English description Gemini Omni understands best

generate.label: Generate
generate.desc: Gemini Omni creates visuals and sound in about 30 s to 1 min

extend.label: Extend
extend.desc: Describe what happens next to make it longer, up to 30 s

step3.tip: Download the video or check the exact English prompt on the right

apiKeyModal.title: API Settings
apiKeyModal.description: API Key is stored only in your browser and used solely to call Google Gemini; it is never logged or stored on the server.

freeMode.description: Server has API Key configured, you can use this tool for free.
freeMode.hint: For faster speed or higher quota, you can enter your own API Key.

connected.title: Connected
connected.description: Your API Key is set up. You can start using all features.

required.title: API Key Required
required.description: Please enter your Gemini API Key to use this tool. API Key is stored only in your browser and used solely to call Google Gemini; it is never logged or stored on the server.

geminiKey.label: Google Gemini API Key
geminiKey.getKeyLink: Get API Key from Google AI Studio
geminiKey.invalid: This doesn't look like an API key: only letters, numbers and symbols, no spaces. Copy the key starting with AIza from Google AI Studio.

mainImage.label: Main image
mainImage.hint: 1 image = animate it; 2-3 images = combine them into a new shot; none = text only

description.label: What motion do you want?
description.placeholder: e.g. the perfume bottle slowly rotates, water drops slide down, soft morning light

audio.label: Audio
audio.sfxHint: No background music, so you can add your own in your editor

modeUploader.endFrameHint: Optional: the video transitions from the main image to this one

negativePrompt.label: Exclude Content
negativePrompt.placeholder: Describe what you don't want in the video, e.g.: blur, text, watermark, distortion...

preview.uploadHint: Your main image will appear here. You can also skip it and use text only

priceEstimate.label: Estimated cost ~{{price}}
priceEstimate.labelUpscaled: Estimated cost from ~{{price}} (1080p / 4K are upscaled and may cost more)

errors.apiKeyRequired: Please set up API key first
errors.apiKeyInvalid: API key is invalid or expired
errors.refineFailed: Failed to refine suggestions. Please try again.
errors.scriptFailed: Failed to generate script. Please try again.
errors.refineScriptFailed: Failed to refine script. Please try again.
errors.noSourceVideo: No source video URI available for extension
errors.pleaseUploadImage: Please upload at least one image
errors.quotaExceeded: API quota exceeded. Please try again later or check your billing settings
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later
errors.cancelFailed: Google could not cancel this shot; it may still be generating and billed
errors.exportFetchFailed: Some shots' videos can no longer be read (e.g. the link expired after a reload). Regenerate them, then download again
errors.mergeMismatch: Some shots were made with different settings (e.g. resolution) and cannot be joined directly. Regenerate them at the same resolution, or use Download all and join them in an editor
errors.contentFiltered: Content was blocked by safety filters. Please modify your image or prompt and try again
errors.contentFilteredChildren: Cannot generate videos from images containing photorealistic children. Please use a different image
errors.contentFilteredViolence: Content was blocked due to violent or harmful imagery. Please use a different image
errors.contentFilteredAdult: Content was blocked due to adult/NSFW content. Please use a different image
errors.contentFilteredCopyright: Blocked as a possible known work, character or celebrity. Replace character names in the prompt with plain descriptions, or use a different image
errors.videoGenerationUnknown: Video generation completed but no video was produced. Please try again with different settings
errors.promptRequired: Enter a description or get an AI suggestion first

workspace.directHint: Send your description to Omni as-is, without AI suggestions

storyboard.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its images and videos are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
storyboard.empty: No projects yet. Click "New project" to start

setup.name: Project name
setup.productsHint: Optional. 1–2 images, sent with every frame. Use a clear front view of the packaging. Without product images the storyboard becomes B-roll (atmosphere only, no product)
setup.referencesHint: Optional, up to 3. Photos of the lead or the setting, sent with every frame so people and places stay the same
setup.packagingText: Packaging text that must stay exact
setup.ratioLocked: The ratio is fixed once the storyboard is confirmed or any frame exists (frames are made at this ratio)

script.sourceImageHint: Optional: a table or storyboard screenshot
script.sourceTextPlaceholder: Paste a script, or describe the video: length, features to show, style…
script.chatPlaceholder: What should change? e.g. make s03 a hand holding the mask
script.confirmGenerate: Confirm storyboard and make frames for {{count}} shots
script.frameSourceExisting: This shot already has frames; switching the source keeps them. To use your own, upload it in step 3 (it becomes the pick); for new AI frames, click Regenerate in step 3
script.frameSourceHint: Shots set to My own are not generated; upload their frames in step 3
script.needInput: Upload a script image or enter text

images.packagingHint: Zoom in and check the packaging text
images.refShotHint: That shot's frame is sent along so people, clothing and setting match. Click Regenerate to apply
images.notePlaceholder: What to change? e.g. short hair
images.finalSizeHint: 1K is enough for video (frames are scaled to 1080px before Omni). 2K / 4K re-render the pick, so details may differ slightly; useful for posters or posts
images.needSelection: Pick a frame for every shot
images.uploadRatioWarning: The uploaded image is not {{ratio}}; it will be center-cropped for video and edges may be cut

status.stopped: Stopped. Shots not yet sent are not billed; running ones were cancelled at Google, which decides whether they are billed

videos.draftFailed: Couldn't fill in the fields; click "Fill in fields with AI" to retry
videos.outdated: The frame changed: this shot's own video was made from the old one; regenerate it only if you need it (the one-take film always reads the latest frames)
videos.exportHint: Finished shots only, in storyboard order. Merging joins them end to end without re-encoding
videos.brief: Describe this shot in your own words
videos.briefPlaceholder: e.g. The camera slowly pushes in, a hand turns the bottle to the front, water drops slide down
videos.briefHint: Replaces the five fields below, including your own edits
videos.redraftFailed: Couldn't rewrite; the fields are unchanged
videos.noVideo: No video yet. Set up the shot on the right and click "Generate this shot"

rail.title: Shots
rail.empty: Shots appear here once the storyboard is built

storyboard.saveError: Saving failed ({{error}}). Your changes are still in this tab and will be retried; if storage is full, delete projects you no longer need.

film.intro: Generate the whole storyboard as one video: segment 1 starts from shot 1's frame, and each later segment extends the video using its first shot's frame as reference. The model handles the transitions.
film.outOfRange: A one-take film must be {{min}}–{{max}} seconds; it is {{seconds}} seconds now. Pick a length above, or adjust the seconds in step 2.
film.withText: Let the model draw the storyboard's on-screen text (small text often comes out wrong; adding it in editing is safer)
film.interrupted: Generation was interrupted; redo the film
film.partial: {{done}}/{{total}} segments done ({{seconds}}s); you can download this part
film.redoHint: Not happy with a transition? Redo from that segment to the end; earlier segments are kept and not paid again. Storyboard edits are applied.
film.transitionsHint: To direct a transition, write it in that shot's Transition column in step 2, e.g. "pull back from the fibers to the mask surface, then to her face"; for a clean cut write "直接切到下一個畫面". A bare cut or fade, or blank, is left to the smooth rules.
film.editHint: Edit one segment: pick it, say what to change, tick reference images. Only that part is replaced, camera and length stay, and you can undo.

edit.placeholder: What should change? e.g. swap the pack for the product in image 1; make the light green; remove the bottle in the back
edit.imagesHint: Pick up to {{max}} reference images; the order you pick them is image 1, 2, 3
edit.textHint: Camera moves, light and length are kept; small print on a swapped pack may not come out exact
